Package edu.cnu.mdi.sim

package edu.cnu.mdi.sim
UI-independent simulation lifecycle abstractions and a background execution engine whose listener callbacks are delivered on the Swing event thread. Implementations place computation in Simulation and expose controls through SimulationEngine.
